2) Top 3 delivery risks and mitigations
3) Any required exec decisions or trade-offs this week (scale-down, scope trim, SLA flexibility)

Chloe —

Short status from engineering (for the QBR slide):

- Launch A (public preview, 2026-03-05): Amber. Core model integration complete; integration tests failing intermittently under 90k concurrent sessions. Mitigation: run an expanded load test on Friday with the new batching config and KV cache patch. If failure persists, we have a fallback plan to limit concurrency via ingress throttles (will increase latency).

- Launch B (beta, 2026-04-02): Green. Model quantization and infra sizing validated. Dependency: final API contract from product by 02/18.

- Launch C (partner deploy with EdgeCloud, 2026-04-20): Red. Network egress / VPC peering issue with EdgeCloud; causing timeouts at scale. Asking partner to prioritize.

Top 3 risks and mitigations (short):
1) Load test instability on Launch A — action: expanded tests + kernel-telemetry; target 02/13 for pass/fail.
2) EdgeCloud peering failure — action: Ops runbook + temporary colocated proxy; need approval to provision proxy (estimated cost: ~$2k/mo)
3) API contract slip for Launch B — action: product to freeze payload by 02/18 or we move launch by 2 weeks.

Exec asks: approve one-time budget for colocated proxy if EdgeCloud can't fix peering by Monday.

-Karthik
Head of Engineering (Serving Runtime)

Thanks Karthik — adding the leadership view for the QBR pack:

- Executive summary (1-2 lines):
Launch A: materially exposed to load instability — contingency required.
Launch B: on track if product freezes API on 02/18.
Launch C (EdgeCloud): high risk; partner remediation timeline unclear — recommend we prepare the colocated proxy plan as a fallback.

- Impact if no mitigations (short):
1) Launch A: degraded user experience, higher latency, potential SLA misses during public preview — reputational/CS impact.
2) Launch B: schedule slip impacting revenue recognition for Q2 pilots.
3) Launch C: delayed partner go-live and potential pushback from partner marketing schedule.

- Recommendations for QBR call (bullets):
* Approve up to $7k one-time contingency for emergency infra/proxy + runbook staffing (covers proxy + 1 week of SRE on-call overtime).
* Product to commit to API contract freeze by 02/18; otherwise move Launch B by two weeks.
* Authorize the cutover checklist as canonical and assign owners today (Chloe to collect).

I’ll include these as the exec asks slide.

-Vivek
VP, Product & Operations
